== run 1: exit 0
espup: OK
espflash.zip: OK
done: in $T/rind-hardware, cargo xtask apply-patches && cargo xtask vendor-ring && cargo xtask build-images esp
the board's USB-Serial/JTAG port needs your user in the dialout (or uucp) group
== run 2: exit 0
done: in $T/rind-hardware, cargo xtask apply-patches && cargo xtask vendor-ring && cargo xtask build-images esp
the board's USB-Serial/JTAG port needs your user in the dialout (or uucp) group
== log
uname -m
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o $T/rind-hardware/.tools/espup https://github.com/esp-rs/espup/releases/download/v0.19.0/espup-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
espup install --targets esp32s3 --toolchain-version 1.97.0.0 --export-file $T/rind-hardware/.tools/export-esp.sh
cargo install --locked ldproxy --version 0.3.5
curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o $T/rind-hardware/.tools/espflash.zip https://github.com/esp-rs/espflash/releases/download/v4.7.0/espflash-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.zip
unzip -o -q espflash.zip (in $T/rind-hardware/.tools)
uname -m
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
espup install --targets esp32s3 --toolchain-version 1.97.0.0 --export-file $T/rind-hardware/.tools/export-esp.sh
cargo install --locked ldproxy --version 0.3.5
